stem.text: A bungee jumper jumps from a platform and is decelerated by an elastic bungee cord, as shown.

stem.alt: Drawing of a bungee jumper standing on a platform beside a coiled bungee cord, with the platform, bungee cord and ground labelled; heading reads before jumping.
Drawing of a bungee jumper hanging below a platform on a bungee cord, with the platform, bungee cord and ground labelled; heading reads during the jump.

stem.text: When the jumper makes the jump, his initial gravitational potential energy relative to the ground is converted into his kinetic energy and into elastic potential energy in the cord.
At which part of the jump are all three types of energy non-zero?

A.text: on the platform before the jump

B.text: on the way down before the cord has started to extend

C.text: on the way down as he decelerates

D.text: at the bottom of the jump when he is stationary
